cases.question: Compare direct and d2c revenue over time.
cases.answer: Direct and d2c are one canonical channel: direct was renamed d2c on June 1, 2022, without historical backfill. Recognized revenue for the combined channel: 2019 1,186,158.36; 2020 1,351,864.37; 2021 1,547,357.51; 2022 1,701,355.74; 2023 1,959,489.18; 2024 2,233,631.88; 2025 2,509,432.38; January–August 2026 1,633,472.88. The 2026 period is partial-year and not directly comparable to full years. Recognition events joined to eligible orders; all-channel annual event totals reconcile exactly to fct_revenue.

sql.text: SELECT DATE_TRUNC(r.recognition_date,YEAR) AS year,o.channel, SUM(r.amount) AS recognized_revenue,MIN(r.recognition_date) AS first_activity_date,MAX(r.recognition_date) AS last_activity_date FROM `nodal-shorelane.shorelane.stg_revenue_recognition` r JOIN `nodal-shorelane.shorelane.fct_orders` o USING(order_id) WHERE o.channel='d2c' AND r.recognition_date<DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY year,o.channel ORDER BY year

WITH events AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(r.recognition_date,YEAR) AS year,SUM(r.amount) AS event_total FROM `nodal-shorelane.shorelane.stg_revenue_recognition` r JOIN `nodal-shorelane.shorelane.fct_orders` o USING(order_id) WHERE r.recognition_date>=DATE '2019-01-01' AND r.recognition_date<DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY year), governed AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(activity_date,YEAR) AS year,SUM(amount) AS governed_total FROM `nodal-shorelane.shorelane.fct_revenue` WHERE measure_name='recognized_revenue' AND activity_date>=DATE '2019-01-01' AND activity_date<DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY year) SELECT year,event_total,governed_total,event_total-governed_total AS difference FROM events JOIN governed USING(year) ORDER BY year

assumptions: Unqualified revenue means recognized revenue.

cases.question: Can order-line sales measure all company revenue?
cases.answer: No. Order lines cover d2c and marketplace consumer sales, exclude subscriptions, and represent gross retail value. Marketplace retail sales are not Shorelane's commission. Use fct_revenue with one selected measure for company revenue; use fct_order_lines for product/category mix, quantities and line margin. Marketplace retail line margin does not establish Shorelane economic margin; marketplace and subscription cost bases are not supplied.

cases.question: What was our renewal rate last quarter?
cases.answer: Renewal rate was 82.38% in Q2 2026: 608 renewed terms / (608 renewed + 130 churned terms). There were zero undecided terms in the queried ending-term cohort. Renewal is identified by a subsequent term's renewed_from_subscription_id; the cohort is anchored on the ending term's end date.

sql.text: WITH ending AS (SELECT s.subscription_id,s.status,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `nodal-shorelane.shorelane.fct_subscriptions` n WHERE n.renewed_from_subscription_id=s.subscription_id AND n.term_start_date <= DATE '2026-09-15') AS renewed FROM `nodal-shorelane.shorelane.fct_subscriptions` s WHERE s.term_end_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND s.term_end_date < DATE '2026-07-01' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `nodal-shorelane.shorelane.dim_customers` c WHERE c.app_db_customer_id=s.customer_id AND c.account_type='customer')) SELECT COUNTIF(renewed) AS renewed_terms, COUNTIF(NOT renewed AND status='churned') AS churned_terms, COUNTIF(NOT renewed AND status!='churned') AS undecided_terms, SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(renewed),COUNTIF(renewed OR status='churned')) AS renewal_rate FROM ending

assumptions: Last quarter means Q2 2026: 2026-04-01 inclusive to 2026-07-01 exclusive, as of 2026-09-15.
Use renewal links observed by 2026-09-15 and churned status for resolved nonrenewals; exclude undecided active terms.
limitations: Frozen definitions are draft simulation inputs; human review is required before production use.

cases.question: Can I join all customer identities to orders to report revenue?
cases.answer: Do not join every identity row directly to orders: multiple aliases, including recreated Stripe identities, can multiply revenue. Resolve native IDs with a LEFT JOIN on both source_system and source_customer_id; keep unresolved IDs as unknown and monitor them as a quality metric. Deduplicate canonical customer IDs before joining order facts, or use EXISTS for membership filters. Count distinct source systems for identity coverage. Attribute invoice/refund events via order_id to eligible fct_orders; tickets need qualified identity resolution.
limitations: Frozen definitions are draft simulation inputs; human review is required before production use.
